Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
digest.tldr: For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public.  CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeline in sight.

digest.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
digest.tldr: Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it.  Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology.
